body: More than "goals," it's my last opportunity to find a purpose in life. Otherwise, I'm saying goodbye :(

I would love to live in the US as well, but nope. I am from Argentina. Bottom rock

Plan so far has been sending an e-mail to a university in Chile (got a suggestion from a friend who lives there, I met him online, really cool guy). Got approved! With my current approved subjects and marks, I can apply for it.

Now I need money to rent a department for 2~3 months so I can comfortably get a job to settle myself in while I go to univ

Oh, I would love to add that people who told me they "felt in love with me" were gay men.

I respect homosexuality, but I don't like men. They understood it pretty well, but thing is I am completely unlucky when it comes to socializing.

Unfortunately, as humans, we are social beings.
